name: Speech to Text
description: Transcribe audio or video to text: with OAIY Voice (service voice:transcribe), a service you add, or a WhisperX server at API URL (word timestamps, speakers).
doc:
Transcribe speech from audio or video files using WhisperX.

Features:
• Word-level timestamps for precise subtitles
• Speaker diarization (identify who's speaking)
• Auto language detection or specify language
• Segment time ranges for partial transcription

Outputs:
• Full Text - complete transcript as string
• Segments - array with timestamps & speaker info
• Language - detected language code
• Duration - audio length in seconds

Requires: WhisperX API server (default: localhost:8770)
Note: Speaker diarization requires HuggingFace token.

inputs.name: Media
inputs.description: Audio or video file path to transcribe

inputs.name: Start Time
inputs.description: Start time in seconds (optional, for segment transcription)

inputs.name: End Time
inputs.description: End time in seconds (optional, for segment transcription)

outputs.name: Segments
outputs.description: Array of transcript segments with timestamps

properties.name: Service
properties.description: Which service writes out the recording. Blank: the WhisperX server at API URL (timestamps and speakers); OAIY Voice and your own services give the text only.

properties.name: API URL
properties.description: The WhisperX server (used when Service is blank)

properties.name: Language
properties.description: Language code (e.g., 'en', 'es'). Leave empty for auto-detect

properties.name: HF Token Constant
properties.description: Name of the constant containing your HuggingFace token (for speaker diarization)
